name: Indirect Depth Supervision (KL Loss)
definition: A regularization technique that uses depth priors to constrain the NeRF weights by aligning the probability distribution of rendering weights with the depth prior, specifically using KL divergence.
summary: Indirect Depth Supervision minimizes KL divergence between rendered weights and a LiDAR-based target distribution, enforcing geometric consistency through distribution alignment rather than penalizing expected depth differences.
